phases.title: Source & protocol
phases.detail: Pinned upstream commit, nested dependencies and official checksums for all 12 data assets. Official training arguments captured directly.

phases.title: H800 environments
phases.detail: Both isolated installations complete. Policy CPU suite: 103 tests passed; world: 24 tests with two retained skips. Both compiled CUDA bundles and actual headless RGB/depth capture plus graceful shutdown passed. Numerical equivalence to the original Docker stack remains unvalidated.

phases.title: Release data
phases.detail: All twelve official assets passed complete official SHA-256 and installation. Original Stage-1 / PhysMani train and validation Datasets also read 64 finite real CPU samples across all 16 tasks; no optimizer or GPU execution in this audit.

phases.title: GPU acceptance
phases.detail: Both CUDA/camera bundles, real WM and WebSocket inference diagnostics passed. Released 3DFA and PhysMani each completed a valid held-out closed-loop smoke with normal simulator exit, including online WM for PhysMani. These two smokes are acceptance only; three measured batch-18/200-update training smokes remain pending.

phases.title: Self collection
phases.detail: All 16 tasks reached two accepted scripted-expert successes, total 32. Across 68 attempt slots, 33 successes were recorded; unused attempts and one infrastructure failure remain preserved. These are expert data, not policy success rates.

phases.title: Fresh WM & packaging
phases.detail: All 32 four-view WM generations and visualizations completed with original budgets. The encoded-depth format adapter passed 384 byte-for-byte comparisons and the original Dataset produced a finite 32-episode batch with four cameras, WM velocity clouds and 8D actions. Failed partial outputs remain preserved.

phases.title: Full training
phases.detail: Controller will run three measured batch-18/200-update smokes after released-model evaluations, then Stage 1, PhysMani Stage 2 and 3DFA at 100,000 updates each, seed 0, three idle cards, batch 18 per card. All official input assets are installed.

phases.title: Policy evaluation
phases.detail: Released 3DFA completed all five checkpoints / 3,200 episodes. Global top-three [99999, 79999, 94999]: 39.11% ± 0.32 percentage points; final checkpoint: 39.53%. PhysMani with online WM is running. Total accepted: 3,200/12,800. Smokes and unfinished tasks are excluded; checkpoint variation is not seed variability.

phases.title: World-model quality
phases.detail: 640 held-out trajectories; horizons 1/5/10 at 0.05 s per frame. PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and depth log RMSE. Official AlexNet/LPIPS cache and finite CPU dependency probe are ready; no WM quality metric yet. Object-center error requires verified GT.

blockers: Full reproduction is unfinished. Released PhysMani evaluation is running. Three measured batch-18/200-update smokes, full training, retrained evaluation and held-out WM quality remain pending.
